name: mister-wolf
description: A local-first project organization for AI assistants: goal-directed processes, project memory and governed learning

scripts.e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config tests/e2e/vitest.config.ts
scripts.pressure-test: npm run build && node dist/bootstrap/cli.js learn gate
scripts.check: node scripts/check-delivery-language.mjs && node scripts/check-glossary-consistency.mjs && node scripts/check-english-surface.mjs && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run test:run
scripts.docs:build: node scripts/generate-cli-reference.mjs && node scripts/generate-cli-site-page.mjs && node scripts/sync-changelog.mjs && vitepress build docs/site
scripts.docs:check: npm run build && npm run docs:build && node scripts/check-docs-links.mjs
